caller_notes: Zero phantoms out of 22. Every row was settled from a company press release, IR page or 8-K exhibit; no date in this file rests on the calendar row alone. The reason is structural — this universe is entirely made up of companies that pre-announce their reporting date and hour by wire, which is the opposite of the 2026-08-31 run 1 population.

Both cadence_implausible flags were false alarms about the date and true alarms about the history. GLOO and IMPP are genuinely reporting; their baseline reaction histories are contaminated by non-earnings filings and must not be inherited as base rates.

SHOE's baseline is empty for a bookkeeping reason. CIK 895447 is Shoe Carnival, renamed Shoe Station Group on 2026-06-11, so the 105 discarded prints are the same operating company and are recoverable. A hunter assigned to SHOE should be told this explicitly.

Two consensus rows look wrong rather than bearish and should be checked before any beat/miss framing: CULP at $0.44 on one estimate against -$0.02 a year ago for a $44m-cap fabric maker, and LAKE at -$0.02 against $0.36. Both are single-estimate rows.
Capacity: YB turns over roughly $300k a day, KEQU and CULP are similarly thin, and GLOO trades about 104k shares. Findings on those names may be unactionable at size even if correct.

Three names have session subtleties worth carrying forward even though all are settled. LSAK releases 09-09 after the close but calls 09-10 at 08:00 ET, so the release carries the 09-09 amc slice. CULP releases 09-09 after the close and calls 09-10 at 09:00 ET, same treatment. SHOE and MCFT and DBI and LOVE and VNCE all release pre-open 09-10 with 08:30-09:00 ET calls, so 09-10 bmo. IMPP and TEN release pre-open with 10:00 ET calls — still bmo, the release precedes the open.
